page.layout: One printed page. Main text in one column on the left, with a running head above and the page number at top right. Marginal notes in the right margin at the lower part of the page, beside the last lines of the column. Gathering signature "Gg 3" and catchword "plaraque" at the foot.

main_text.p: one & devotionis studio ad terminum sinceritatis, & unionis simplicis[?] pervenerint. Imò conspici illum oculis in hoc mundo, & visere ipsos, ipsosque illum visere. Davidis cujusdam Al Jawariensis hæc ab eo refertur sententia ان معبودة جسم ولحم ودم وله جوارح واعضا من يد ورجل وراس ولسان وعينين وانذين ومع ذلك جسم لا كالاجسام ولحم لا كالحوم ودم لا كالدما وكذلك سائر الصفات وهولا يشبه شيا من المخلوقات ولا يشبهه شي وحكي عنه انه قال هو اجوف من اعلاه الي ضروه[?] مصمت ماسوا ذلك وان له وفرة[?] سودا ولة شعر قطط

Esse scil. Deum ipsius, corpus & carnem, & sanguinem, & esse ei partes & membra, puta, Manus, pedes, caput, linguam, oculos, aures, ita tamen ut sit corpus non ut alia corpora; caro non ut aliæ carnes; sanguis non ut alius sanguis; idémq; de reliquis attributis dicendum, nec similem esse eum ulli è rebus creatis, nec ei rem aliquà similem. Narratur insuper dixisse ipsū, esse eum à vertice usq; ad pectus concavi, deorsum verò solidum esse ei cesariem nigrā, capillum crispum. Porrò quæ in Alcorano afferuntur juxta sensum literalem intelligi voluerunt, ut communiter corporibus congruunt, ut & illud à Mohammede dictum, Deum Idem Obaidianorum qui sekta quædam Moriiorum error, teste Shareftaniohominem juxta formam suam creasse, & sensisse se digitos Dei frigidos quibus humerum ipsi tangeret. quinimo multa eos tradit idem Shareftanius, dicta Mohammedi ad opinionem suam confirmandam affinxisse, اكثرها مقتبسة من اليهود quorum plaraque

page.notes: Right margin note, lower part: printed "*Idem Obaidi-anorum qui se-Eta quedam Moriiorum er-ror, teste Sha-reftan." The word "Eta" (probably the end of "sekta") and "Moriiorum" (probably "Moriorum") are doubtful; the note is rendered with the printed hyphens joined. The mark "*" in the text after "Deum" is the reference to this note. Doubtful readings in the Arabic: the lines are copied from the scan, and the words "ضروه" and "وفرة" are marked [?]. "simplicis" is marked [?] because the scan reads "simpltcis". The word "ipsū" is printed with a macron over the u. Catchword "plaraque" is at the right below the last line; the last line of the column ends with "quorum". Running head and page number are at the top of the page. The printed "Gg 3" is the gathering signature.
